withdrawnProvisionalCandidates.reason: The source сон can refer to a dream or sleep; the shipped catalog explicitly contains EDream.BodyEater. Evidence does not justify requiring pagtulog instead of the existing panaginip.

Sunog sa araw can serve as a colloquial character moniker for being darkened by the sun; the referent is preserved. Requiring the glossary synonym would be a preference, not a demonstrated objective defect.
Babae denotes a female without requiring adulthood. Munting babae and the child scene preserve the source female child referent; batang babae would be an optional clarity variant.
Sa iisang bubong is an intelligible shared-roof metonymy. The absence of ilalim does not establish loss of the shared-home fact.
Malao’t madali is a traditional contraction of the idiom; expanding it to malaon at madali is an optional orthographic variant, not a proven typo.
